pai.id, pai.sn, pai.phone_type, pai.imei1, pai.imei2, pai.model, pai.info_id, pai.store_id, pai.skip_api_call, pai.old_phone_status, pai.old_phone_usage_months, pai.create_time, pai.create_by, pai.nick_name, pai.update_time, pai.update_by
pad.activated, pad.activate_date, pad.coverage, pad.active_info, pad.sys_time, pad.image_path

mapper.select:
SELECT , ,
FROM phone_active_info pai LEFT JOIN phone_active_detail pad ON pai.id = pad.order_id LEFT JOIN phone_order_contract poc ON pai.id = poc.order_id WHERE pai.sn = #{sn}

SELECT , , , li.name, li.phone_num, sd.dept_name AS store_name FROM phone_active_info pai LEFT JOIN phone_active_detail pad ON pai.id = pad.order_id LEFT JOIN phone_order_contract poc ON pai.id = poc.order_id LEFT JOIN leave_information li ON pai.info_id = li.id LEFT JOIN sys_dept sd ON pai.store_id = sd.dept_id WHERE pai.id = #{id}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalOrders, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(pai.create_time) = STR_TO_DATE(#{currentDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS todayOrders, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN pad.activated = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS activatedDevices, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN pad.activated = 0 OR pad.activated IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pendingOrders, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN poc.signature_date IS NOT NULL AND poc.signature_date != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS signedOrders, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN poc.signature_date IS NOT NULL AND poc.signature_date != '' AND DATE(pai.create_time) = STR_TO_DATE(#{currentDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS todaySignedOrders, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN poc.signature_date IS NOT NULL AND poc.signature_date != '' AND DATE(pai.create_time) = STR_TO_DATE(#{previousDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS yesterdaySignedOrders, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(pai.create_time) = STR_TO_DATE(#{previousDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS yesterdayOrders, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(pai.create_time, '%Y-%m') = #{currentMonth} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS currentMonthOrders, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(pai.create_time, '%Y-%m') = #{previousMonth} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS previousMonthOrders FROM phone_active_info pai LEFT JOIN phone_active_detail pad ON pai.id = pad.order_id LEFT JOIN phone_order_contract poc ON pai.id = poc.order_id

SELECT COUNT(*) AS myTotalOrders, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(pai.create_time) = STR_TO_DATE(#{currentDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS myTodayOrders, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN pad.activated = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS myActivatedDevices, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN pad.activated = 0 OR pad.activated IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS myPendingOrders, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN poc.signature_date IS NOT NULL AND poc.signature_date != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS mySignedOrders, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN poc.signature_date IS NOT NULL AND poc.signature_date != '' AND DATE(pai.create_time) = STR_TO_DATE(#{currentDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS myTodaySignedOrders, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN poc.signature_date IS NOT NULL AND poc.signature_date != '' AND DATE(pai.create_time) = STR_TO_DATE(#{previousDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS myYesterdaySignedOrders, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(pai.create_time) = STR_TO_DATE(#{previousDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS myYesterdayOrders, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(pai.create_time) BETWEEN STR_TO_DATE(#{recentSevenDaysStart}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND STR_TO_DATE(#{currentDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS myRecentSevenDaysOrders, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(pai.create_time) BETWEEN STR_TO_DATE(#{previousSevenDaysStart}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND STR_TO_DATE(#{previousSevenDaysEnd}, '%Y-%m-%d') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS myPreviousSevenDaysOrders FROM phone_active_info pai LEFT JOIN phone_active_detail pad ON pai.id = pad.order_id LEFT JOIN phone_order_contract poc ON pai.id = poc.order_id WHERE pai.create_by = #{createBy}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(pai.create_time, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(*) AS orderCount, SUM(CASE WHEN pad.activated = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS activatedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN poc.signature_date IS NOT NULL AND poc.signature_date != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS signedCount FROM phone_active_info pai LEFT JOIN phone_active_detail pad ON pai.id = pad.order_id LEFT JOIN phone_order_contract poc ON pai.id = poc.order_id WHERE DATE_FORMAT(pai.create_time, '%Y-%m') >= #{startMonth} AND DATE_FORMAT(pai.create_time, '%Y-%m') <= #{endMonth} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(pai.create_time, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month ASC
SELECT CASE WHEN model IS NULL OR TRIM(model) = '' THEN '未知型号' ELSE model END AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM phone_active_info GROUP BY name ORDER BY value DESC, name ASC LIMIT 10

SELECT COALESCE( SUM( CASE WHEN pad.coverage IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(pad.coverage) != '' AND STR_TO_DATE(SUBSTRING(pad.coverage, 1, 10), '%Y-%m-%d') > DATE_ADD(STR_TO_DATE(#{currentDate}, '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 30 DAY) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), 0 ) AS inWarrantyCount, COALESCE( SUM( CASE WHEN pad.coverage IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(pad.coverage) != '' AND STR_TO_DATE(SUBSTRING(pad.coverage, 1, 10), '%Y-%m-%d') >= STR_TO_DATE(#{currentDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND STR_TO_DATE(SUBSTRING(pad.coverage, 1, 10), '%Y-%m-%d') <= DATE_ADD(STR_TO_DATE(#{currentDate}, '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 30 DAY) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), 0 ) AS nearExpiryCount, COALESCE( SUM( CASE WHEN pad.coverage IS NULL OR TRIM(pad.coverage) = '' OR STR_TO_DATE(SUBSTRING(pad.coverage, 1, 10), '%Y-%m-%d') IS NULL OR STR_TO_DATE(SUBSTRING(pad.coverage, 1, 10), '%Y-%m-%d') < STR_TO_DATE(#{currentDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), 0 ) AS expiredCount FROM phone_active_info pai LEFT JOIN phone_active_detail pad ON pai.id = pad.order_id
SELECT contract_content FROM phone_order_contract WHERE order_id = #{id}
